item.text:
This pass captured the final artifact and confirmed the tree is back to a clean, verified state.

**What I added**

- `audit/cover/audit_matrix.log` — the exact pass/fail matrix of the **audited** tree, saved for review and referenced from the report:
  - `internal/raft`: PASS fuzz, in-memory model, proposal control, vote-restart; FAIL the two F2 reproductions and F3.
  - `raftpb`: PASS entry-encoding property test.
  - root package: PASS the eight negative-result/characterisation tests; FAIL only the F1 one-tick reproduction.

**Audit state**

Three findings, all with executed reproductions and a verified minimal fix:

- F1 — `(*nodeUser).ReadIndex` in [nodehost.go](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/nodehost.go:2063) never wakes the execution engine; ~one RTT added latency, one-RTT timeouts deterministically fail (two-RTT succeeds), while `NodeHost.ReadIndex` completes.
- F2 — `handleCandidateReadIndex` in [raft.go](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/internal/raft/raft.go:1998) records a dropped ReadIndex twice; visible in `Peer.GetUpdate`, idempotent downstream.
- F3 — `pb.Update.HasUpdate` in [raftpb/raft.go](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/raftpb/raft.go:112) ignores `DroppedReadIndexes`, contradicting `Peer.HasUpdate`.

`audit/diag-fixes/` applies exactly those three hunks; with them every audit test passes and the default `internal/raft`, `raftpb` and root suites remain green. The audited work tree is byte-identical to `../source`, and default suites pass as run.

[report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/report.md) (489 lines) contains the summary, three findings with expected/actual/conditions/evidence, source-based observations, the reviewed-areas catalogue (including the negative-result fuzz/model/property tests and the pebble-vs-rocksdb durability comparison), reproduction inventory, fix verification, command log and unresolved work. Remaining effort would be speculative source review; every buildable component has been executed.
